name: PandaDoc MCP
description: Creates, sends and tracks PandaDoc contracts, proposals and templates from your AI client, with signature status, reminders and document analytics.

skills.name: Create Documents from Templates
skills.description: Creates PandaDoc documents such as NDAs, contracts and sales proposals with pricing tables from your existing templates.

skills.name: Track Signature Status
skills.description: Checks whether a document has been signed and finds all documents still waiting for signatures, with recipients and wait time.

skills.name: Send Documents and Reminders
skills.description: Sends documents to their recipients and sends reminder emails to recipients who haven't signed within a set number of days.

skills.name: Search and Filter Documents
skills.description: Searches documents by full text and filters them by value, tag, status, expiry or signing date, like contracts signed last quarter.

skills.name: Document Analytics
skills.description: Reports document counts by status, completion rates and average signing time, and shows the full audit trail for a document.
